text: Unsealed successor proposal at source 43e217c014017831cd3485b2e3c117451560a29e; current-main steering reconciled at 348796bca4b896b123def681b18941490de4d393. Writable paths are scripts/proof-receipt-contract.js, test/scripts/proof-receipt-execution-report.test.js and this Quest's proposal and append-only evidence. The first source commit changes controls only. Producer scripts/proof-authority.js::validatedExecution emits reportDigest, producer and summary; consumer receiptProblems currently never requires them. Exact lookup, identity lookup, indexProof and recordProof reuse all consume evaluateReceipt. Original-compatible tests will retain native valid producer receipts in a separate bare fixture store, plant distinct adverse tags on the observed store, and assert refusal without deleting or replacing original objects or refs. Exclude report schema and producer validation, identity algorithm, retry policy, publisher/process ownership, broad WIP and historical sealed records. No positive direct-count requirement applies to a release legitimately citing its exact corpus receipt; command labels and integer assertions are not invented requirements. The prior 207d4f792 decision deliberately kept pre-report receipts applicable; current no-legacy direction supersedes that active behavior while preserving its historical claim. No execution, original causal measurement, seal or acceptance is claimed by this proposal.

Original-compatible controls are frozen at 8598cc15592f459fd7a8f0ebebbbc4ce3622e40e, test blob e7e53b39158518561557ee51642241279ffe3c9c, before the separate source repair. Source review expects 27 added causal negatives; only physical output may establish actual engagement or totals. Candidate repair adds one private applicability check at receiptProblems, shared by exact resolution, identity resolution, indexing and recording reuse. The envelope requires the current report digest, producer attribution and all summary fields, successful command exits, strict zero passedOnRetry and only registered citable proof references. Nonnegative numeric counts may be zero; assertions may be fractional; command labels remain optional; producer attribution retains the existing report validator's truthy kind/id contract. No report replay, inferred positive count, planned/executed equality or historical rewrite is introduced. The source census found no other positive buildReceipt-only consumer to migrate: proof-authority.test.js uses it only for producer attribution, release-proof-identity.test.js uses it for intentionally invalid historical identity receipts, and its valid identity/index controls already record through the real owner. Those existing roots remain focused proof obligations. Original controls, physical candidate proof, independent verification and sealing remain pending.

Independent review of candidate 5889425f7 identified one omitted, directly visible producer invariant: shapeProblems rejects an empty plan with no cited proof. The receipt reader must preserve that conditional rule without requiring positive direct counts when a release lawfully cites its exact corpus. Original-controls successor dcd5b9a11094edcda6da94a38643904df63a01fb adds one real-tag empty-plan control while preserving production blob 559e1b230d2cba0a052195f49e64d94580873195; frozen test blob is db1e0c3e11c04d1ce4bac1770e7d08c10a01d4c4. This explicitly supersedes only the proposed control selection at 8598cc155, which remains preserved. Source review now expects 28 added causal-negative cases, not a measured result. The candidate applies that same test and the producer's conditional refusal; all previous original and candidate evidence remains unmodified. Independent rereview and physical measurement are still owed.
